immutable_evidence_statement: The original result in live-v2-frozen-challenge-v2.json remains immutable and is not modified, replaced, or deleted.
provenance_statement: The report proves live Gemini execution and model provenance but is not used as product-quality evidence due to objective benchmark fixture defects.

defects.description: Extractor production prompt explicitly requires quotes to represent the full supporting credit requirement clause. Multi-person obligations share the clause quote. V2 gold annotations incorrectly contained individual name-only spans.

All four positive Steward fixtures used issue_code=MISSING_CREDIT, but expected SUBSTITUTE_TEXT, REORDER, REGROUP, and REPOSITION patch operations which are not derivable from MISSING_CREDIT under Steward deterministic issue mapping.
The report stored the complete-corpus digest (full_fixture_corpus_digest) rather than the target split digest (evaluated_fixture_set_digest).
